messages.author: 2a3a0c6a456f3043
messages.subject: nonparametric bootstrap for pcountOpen
parts:
Hi Richard,

I tried to run a nonparametric bootstrap for a Dail-Madsen model and got the error:

Error in unmarkedFramePCO(y = getY(multf), siteCovs = siteCovs(multf), :
Dimensions of primaryPeriod matrix should be MxT

I would think that the original model wouldn't have worked if my PP weren't MxT but I checked anyway and they are (98 x 4). My count matrix is 98 x 16 (with 3 columns of NA as I had 3 PP with 3 observations and 1 PP with 4 observations per site).

I remember seeing that as of unmarked version 0.9-5 (I'm running v0.9-8 in R v2.15.1) nonparboot was supposed to work for all unmarked models. I didn't see pcountOpen model fit as an option in the nonparboot help file. Has nonparboot been implemented for pcountOpen model fits?

Thanks,
Dan
